events.summary: Descenders, This is a big one. The descent now has someone to show you the way, there are new elites for those who want punishment, and Borrowed Flesh speaks two more languages. The rag Jester teaches you to survive The tutorial now has a narrator: a fairground jester who has hung from his strings for far too long. events.title: The Borrowed Flesh demo is out: play Act 1 for free
events.summary: The demo is here You can now download the Borrowed Flesh demo for free. It's a deckbuilding roguelike steeped in body horror: Slay the Spire meets Fear & Hunger. Your party dies for real, sanity is just another resource to spend, and every decision matters. What's inside The complete Act 1, from the first room to the boss that guards it. You start with three heroes: Amós the Butcher, Isolt the Medic and Sela the Huntress. They share a single deck; when one falls, their cards become useless. Beat
